card.name: Space before a dose number
card.fires_on: The space or joining mark right before a dose amount, mostly after a drug name such as umeclidinium or after a comma in a dose list. Also fires on 'stimulator' before riociguat.

modes.label: Gap before dose
modes.description: A blank space after a drug name or dose phrase, just before a number with mcg or mg.

modes.label: Stimulator before riociguat
modes.description: The ending of 'stimulator' just before the drug name riociguat.

modes.label: Joiner in combo names
modes.description: An 'and' or slash linking two drugs in a combination product name.

card.plain: It marks the spot just before a drug's strength number, especially in inhaler and combination product labels.
